name: BeSafe-Bench
summary: Evaluates the behavioural safety of agents in web, mobile, embodied-VLM and embodied-VLA domains. The VLM domain executes skill plans in OmniGibson through the IS-Bench interface, and the VLA domain uses LIBERO.
numbers: 1,312 executable tasks, 9 risk categories, 13 agents; best agent safe on under 40%

why.dex: Skill primitives in OmniGibson; LIBERO policies.
why.cog: Safety constraints added to ordinary tasks.
why.xr: Household accidents and digital side effects.
